newsitem.title: CANADA: Bema may consider partner in Chile.
newsitem.headline: Bema may consider partner in Chile.

text.p: Bema Gold Corp said it may consider seeking a rich partner to develop its Aldebaran gold and copper property in Chile.

Based on very preliminary figures, the Cerro Casale deposit would probably require between C$1 billion and C$1.2 billion to bring into production, Bema president Clive Johnson told analysts late Wednesday.
"Raising $1 billion might be a stretch for Bema," he said. "We might look at bringing in a major partner."
A decision was years away as Bema continued drilling to determine the boundaries of the deposit, he said.
